paragraphs: Edlio sells a single platform covering a school or district website, a mobile app, mass communications and online payments. The customers are K-12 schools and districts across the country.

The website is meant to be one a school team can manage without writing code. News, calendars, forms and newsletters are published from one content management system built for educators. A single message reaches families by app, email, text, voice and social media, with translation built in. Payments cover fees, ticket sales and a school store without a separate checkout.

Newer additions improve PDF accessibility from inside the content system. Sensitive records can be sent to the right family without leaving the platform. The company has announced agentic workflows for its K-12 school website content system. A customer story on the site features Abbott ISD.

quote.text: The all-in-one platform for school websites, mobile apps, mass communications, and payments.
